description: Diff a board's current postings against the last time this tool was called for the same ats+board_token (snapshot kept in KV, dated). The FIRST call for a board has no prior snapshot, so it returns every current job as new (snapshot_bootstrap:true) rather than a misleading empty diff. Pass "since" (ISO date) to also require posted_at >= since where the ATS reports a date.

ats.description: Which ATS the board is on.

since.description: Optional ISO-8601 date/time; only postings with posted_at on or after this (where the ATS reports a date) count as new.

name: ats_new_postings
title: Ats New Postings
